nodes.label: desktop memory - the generator is a neutral pipe

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The v3 shared generator (orchestrator.build_shared_generator) sends the model one fixed system instruction - 'Answer the question using only the provided documents. Be concise.' - then the question exactly as posed in the dataset plus the arm's retrieved passages as a labelled user turn, with output a structured {answer} as a format constraint only and never content, at temperature=0 with thinking disabled for reproducibility. The instruction is generic grounding, not retrieval engineering, and is held byte-identical across all three arms so the only variable stays the retrieval. The line: generic RAG grounding is allowed, but behavioural steering that manufactures scoring artifacts is not - specifically no forced abstention or 'I don't know' string. A forced abstention instruction made the model emit 'I don't know' on about 61% of a gold-100 vector run, and an audit of those 55 abstentions found 0 over-abstentions, every one a genuine retrieval miss - but the clean refusal token was an artifact of the prompt rather than native behaviour, and it masks what is measured. If an arm wants smarter handling of thin or empty context, that lives inside THAT arm's own code, never in the shared generator
